name: rezervo-kosova
description: Multi-tenant booking infrastructure for Kosovo businesses.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @rezervo/api" "npm run dev -w @rezervo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rezervo/shared && npm run build -w @rezervo/api && npm run build -w @rezervo/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rezervo/api && npm run lint -w @rezervo/web
